name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: The adventurer with the Viper familiar's gold is between the Halfling and Kael.
The Bard's gold is at least 10 gp more than the adventurer with the Toad familiar.

Wolf goes with either Mara or Bard (but not both).
The Paladin's gold is immediately below the Halfling.
The Rogue's gold is at least 20 gp more than the Tiefling.
The adventurer with the Toad familiar's gold is immediately below the Human.
